title: TURN HMAC key published in relay descriptor
description: SPEC l.2710 publishes the TURN shared HMAC key in the descriptor, so anyone can mint TURN credentials and use the relay as an open TURN server. Fix: keep the key secret; issue short-lived credentials via an authenticated/quota-scoped exchange (see Q2 agora-pozi.9). Line numbers refer to import/ files (notes/research-2026-10-16.md).
